profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer passionate about developing performant, modular and scalable JavaScript applications with React, Node/Express and GraphQL. Contributor to Obsidian, Deno's first native GraphQL caching client and server module.

Recent talks include "The Current State of State Management: Redux, MobX, Context API, and Recoil" for Single Sprout's speaker series.

Find me on GitHub: https://github.com/ericmarc159

positions.description: UI Developer on Goldman Sachs Prime Services Risk Analytics team.

positions.title: Software Engineer @ Goldman Sachs
positions.description: UI Developer on Goldman Sachs Franchise Analytics team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Utilized React Context to establish a global state management, permitting wrapped components access to stateful logic and client-side caching, regardless of component hierarchy.
-Designed complex algorithms and parsers to eliminate over and under fetching, by orchestrating a caching structure to boost performance speed after fetching to a GraphQL endpoint, and perform CRUD functionality on cache structure.
-Incorporated TypeScript for it’s strong static typing to reduce runtime errors and increase maintainability through self-documenting code.
-Implemented a Redis in-memory database to minimize access times and ensure atomic operations on our server-side cache.
-Utilized AWS to deploy demo app by configuring an Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) server with Dockerized application to ensure future scalability.
-Constructed a TDD  workflow by implementing Rhum to provide unit testing, allowing for descriptive and readable test-suites to determine that CRUD functionality and parsers are executing correctly and to ensure a consistent and accelerated development process. 
-Product developed under tech developer OS Labs(opensourcelabs.io)

positions.title: Codarena | Competitive multiplayer algorithm challenge
positions.description:
-Created and utilized a NoSQL database with Mongoose ODM to leverage schema validation, fast lookup speed and seamless incorporation of new functionality.
-Applied Websockets to construct a bidirectional communication system between client and server,  allowing for real-time data follow, which permitted for live display of players solving algorithms and a chatroom.
-Architected an event-driven state management system, leveraging React Hooks, for predictable and unidirectional data flow in order to reduce prop-drilling and handle asynchronous behavior.

positions.title: 6Figure Planner
positions.description:
-Created modular React components to capitalize on tree reconciliation, construct an interactive UI, and reduce front-end load time for optimal performance.
-Utilized OAuth to handle user verification to simplify the login process, and to gain access to the user’s profile data from the database.
-Employed custom Webpack configuration to exercise granular control over the bundling of JavaScript files in React frontend and Express backend, minifying and uglifying code to improve performance and customizing the app’s development and production environment.

positions.title: Covid-Risk-Assessment | Risk Analysis Tool
positions.description:
-Generated a SPA using React Router for dynamic client-side routing to minimize the total number of server requests and boosted loading performance.
-Utilized BCrypt to design a secure and seamless login process with cookie-based session storage and hashed passwords, in order to protect valuable data and resources.
-Implemented a PostgreSQL database to store relational data, permitting users to perform CRUD functionality on stored data and display changes to other users by leveraging many to many relationships, while enforcing ACID compliance.
-Employed Node.js server with Express framework, to broker HTTP/API requests in nonblocking, asynchronous middleware to route data to and from a relational database and perform CRUD operations.
